description: A live trading desk built on the Svelte 5 data grid: 10,000 securities tick on a 500 ms feed while the grid stays at 60 fps. Symbol is pinned left and P&L pinned right, cells pulse green or red on each price move, every row carries a 30-point sparkline, and a KPI strip recomputes across all rows on every tick with $derived. It uses the same SvGrid primitives as every other example, with rows held in $state.raw so each tick hands the grid one new array reference instead of 10,000 cell mutations.

faq.question: How does the grid stay smooth with 10,000 rows updating every 500 ms?
faq.answer: Row virtualization only renders the rows in view, and the demo keeps its rows in $state.raw so a tick replaces the array once instead of mutating 10,000 reactive objects. Only about 5 percent of rows change per tick, and the sparkline path is recomputed only for rows whose reference changed.

faq.question: How are the cell flashes done?
faq.answer: A pulses map is rebuilt on every tick with the ids and directions of the rows that moved. Cell snippets read it to add a green or red class, and because the map is replaced rather than appended to, stale pulses disappear on the next tick without any cleanup timer.

faq.question: Do I need special APIs to pin columns and add sparklines?
faq.answer: No. Symbol and P&L are pinned with the grid prop initialColumnPinning={{ left: ["symbol"], right: ["pnl"] }}, and the sparkline is a plain Svelte snippet rendering an SVG path from the row's rolling buffer. Everything in this demo is available in @svgrid/grid.
